summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to their season with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Tatters scoring an early goal that proved decisive in a hard-fought encounter. The Bach showed resilience throughout, keeping a clean sheet despite some pressure from their visitors, and will be looking to build on this positive opening. Striker Stan Tatters has already attracted sponsorship support from Calibre Control, underlining the club's optimistic start to the new campaign.
